name: OnePlus / OPPO / realme (ColorOS, OxygenOS)
note: OxygenOS and realme UI are both ColorOS underneath since 2021, so the package names overlap heavily. ColorOS is unusually aggressive about killing background apps; the battery section of this tool can loosen that.

packages.label: HeyTap Cloud
packages.note: Cloud backup and Find My Device stop.

packages.label: App Market
packages.note: OEM app store, and an ad-notification source. OnePlus system apps update through it.

packages.label: Pictorial lock-screen magazine
packages.note: Rotating lock-screen images, some sponsored. Also a wake-up source.

packages.label: HeyTap Push (MCS)
packages.note: OPPO's push channel. Carries promotional pushes, but some OEM apps use it for real notifications.

packages.label: Phone Manager
packages.note: Also hosts some Settings pages on ColorOS.

packages.label: OPlus Account
packages.note: Signs you out of the OnePlus/OPPO account. Find My Device and cloud backup stop with it.

packages.label: OnePlus Launcher
packages.note: On OxygenOS this is the home screen. Install another launcher and set it as Home first.

packages.label: Security Center
packages.note: Permissions and startup management hang off this.

packages.label: Battery Manager
packages.note: ColorOS charging control. Disabling it has bricked charging behaviour on some builds.
